subproblem.title: The area integrand J is C^infinity
subproblem.statement:
For all natural numbers n, l, with e_a = EuclideanSpace.single a 1 and G(P)_{ab} =

, the function J(P) = sqrt(det(I_n + G(P))) on the normed space L = L(R^n, R^l) (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ with the operator norm) is C^infinity (ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞)).
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ n ℓ : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fun P : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ => Real.sqrt (Matrix.det ((1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) + Matrix.of fun a b : Fin n => inner ℝ (P (EuclideanSpace.single a (1 : ℝ))) (P (EuclideanSpace.single b (1 : ℝ))))))
subproblem.natural_proof:
Notation: fix n, l. L := Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, M(P) := I + G(P) (a real n x n matrix) and D(P) := det M(P). 1. Smooth entries. For fixed a, P -> P e_a is the continuous linear evaluation map L -> R^l at e_a, hence C^infinity. The real inner product is a continuous bilinear map, so P ->

is C^infinity (ContDiff.inner). Adding the constant (I)_{ab}, every entry P -> M(P)_{ab} is C^infinity. 2. Smooth determinant. By the Leibniz formula (Matrix.det_apply), D(P) = sum over permutations sigma of Fin n of sign(sigma) * prod_i M(P)_{sigma(i), i}. A finite product of C^infinity real functions is C^infinity (contDiff_prod). Multiplying by the constant sign(sigma) in {1, -1} preserves C^infinity. A finite sum of C^infinity functions is C^infinity (ContDiff.sum). Hence D is C^infinity on L. 3. Positivity. By the sibling gram_det_pos (Submission.dohr_eb_ail_gram_det_pos), D(P) > 0, in particular D(P) != 0, for every P in L. 4. Square root. If D : L -> R is C^infinity and D(P) != 0 for all P, then P -> sqrt(D(P)) is C^infinity, because sqrt is C^infinity away from 0 (ContDiff.sqrt). Therefore J = sqrt o D is C^infinity on L. QED Source: parent step 2. Lean note (checked at the pin; a complete proof compiled): there is no smoothness lemma for Matrix.det at the pin and Matrix has no global norm instance, so work on scalar entries through the Leibniz formula. - Entries: after `simp only [Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.of_apply]`, `exact contDiff_const.add (ContDiff.inner ℝ (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ (Rn ℓ) (EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ))).contDiff (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ (Rn ℓ) (EuclideanSpace.single b (1:ℝ))).contDiff)`. - Determinant: `simp only [Matrix.det_apply, Units.smul_def, zsmul_eq_mul]; refine ContDiff.sum (fun σ _ => ?_); exact contDiff_const.mul (contDiff_prod (fun i _ => hentry _ _))`. - Finish with `hdet.sqrt (fun P => (Submission.dohr_eb_ail_gram_det_pos n ℓ P).ne')`.
